mapper.select: SELECT s.academic_year AS year, IF(s.term = 'FIRST', 1, 2) AS semester, c.name AS course_name, c.code AS course_code, c.credits, IFNULL(g.letter_grade, '미입력') AS grade, CASE WHEN g.letter_grade = 'A+' THEN 4.5 WHEN g.letter_grade = 'A0' THEN 4.0 WHEN g.letter_grade = 'B+' THEN 3.5 WHEN g.letter_grade = 'B0' THEN 3.0 WHEN g.letter_grade = 'C+' THEN 2.5 WHEN g.letter_grade = 'C0' THEN 2.0 WHEN g.letter_grade = 'D+' THEN 1.5 WHEN g.letter_grade = 'D0' THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END AS grade_point FROM enrollments e JOIN lectures l ON e.lecture_id = l.id JOIN courses c ON l.course_id = c.id JOIN semesters s ON l.semester_id = s.id LEFT JOIN grades g ON g.enrollment_id = e.id JOIN students st ON e.student_id = st.id WHERE st.user_id = #{studentId} ORDER BY s.academic_year DESC, s.term DESC

SELECT c.name AS course_name, a.lecture_date, a.status FROM attendances a JOIN enrollments e ON a.enrollment_id = e.id JOIN lectures l ON e.lecture_id = l.id JOIN courses c ON l.course_id = c.id JOIN students st ON e.student_id = st.id WHERE st.user_id = #{studentId} ORDER BY a.lecture_date DESC
